Configuration: logic capture at 1 MS/s on the keyer test point, the A and B lines of both encoders and the display chip-select; the keying fixture scripts the paddle contacts to send PARIS five times in Iambic A (closures as in TC-SW-KEYER-013); both encoders turned by the encoder-turning fixture (docs/vv/fixtures/encoder-turner.md, planned) at 50 detents per second each (the REQ-SW-KEYER-014 load) in alternating direction pairs (one detent toward the interior of the setting range, then one back), so every detent is processed and each controlled setting returns to its start value after each pair; where an encoder is the keyer speed control, each element is compared with the nominal of either speed in force (the start speed and its one-step neighbour, the only two the pairs produce) and the report records the encoder functions from the operations handbook; the display frame rate is taken from the chip-select activity and must reach 50 full-frame transfers per second for a loaded capture to count; if the release UI does not refresh that fast, the instrumented test build of TC-SW-KEYER-034 with its full-frame refresh option supplies the load; dummy load; 0.5 W step. Credit row: T-SW-TARGET. Test of a software requirement that depends on target timing, closed by Bench on the delivered unit (docs/process/04-verification-and-validation.md section 5.2 row T-SW-TARGET; target timing closes at Bench, never by Emulation, CON-025), run after the TRR that opens the campaign (section 13), witnessed by the owner, on the tagged release named in the VDD; HostUnit and dev-board evidence named in the verification_note is supporting only. The logic capture and the keying fixture are credit-bearing only after their TV records exist (docs/cm/tool-validation/TV-NNN-logic-capture.md; the fixture pattern timing is checked against the capture in the session reference check); until then the case is Blocked (docs/process/04-verification-and-validation.md sections 4 and 6). Credentials: instruments and tools per tools/toolchain.lock.md at the commit recorded in the report. Safety: every transmission goes into the 50 ohm dummy load or the calibrated power attenuator, connected before power-on, never into an open antenna port; key-down duty kept within the load rating recorded in the report; anyone other than the operator stays 0.6 m or more from the unit and load while keying and 1.0 m or more during a tune carrier (NGO-019); the bench supply current limit is set before each power-on; antistatic wrist strap while the lid is off; the PA area is not touched after key-down runs; the stuck-key abort of the operations handbook (HZ-004 K11: unplug the key, then switch the PA supply off) is ready at every keyed step. Environment: room temperature 18 to 28 C; the pack is supplied by the bench supply at 7.4 V +/-0.05 V through the battery terminals unless a step sets another value; dummy load or calibrated attenuator on the antenna port.
procedure: Name the owner (witness and operator) and Claude (conductor) in the report; confirm that the TRR decision memo that opens this campaign exists and names CWHT-A-001 and this release.

With the supply off, connect the dummy load to the antenna port, the fixtures and the logic-capture leads the Configuration line names; set the bench supply to 7.4 V with the current limit of docs/reviews/TRR/test-configuration-record.md for this configuration.
Before the first powered step, run picotool verify of the installed image against the release UF2 named in the VDD and record the match.
Run the logic-capture reference pulse-train check of this session and record the result (docs/process/04-verification-and-validation.md section 4).
Select Iambic A at 5 WPM; start a capture; the keying fixture sends PARIS five times with the encoders idle; save the capture (baseline).
Repeat the previous step with the encoder-turning fixture running throughout the capture.
Repeat the two previous steps at 25 WPM and at 50 WPM.
Run tools/analyze_keyer_capture.py on each capture: every dit, dah and inter-element space with its error against the nominal, the display full-frame rate and each encoder's detent rate.
Record instrument calibration state, capture firmware version, tool versions and the firmware version in the report, and the measured values for MOP-012 and TPM-013.
On any discrepancy, stop and open an NCR per docs/process/04-verification-and-validation.md section 10.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Pass if in every capture with the encoders turning every dit, dah and inter-element space at the keyer test point is within +/-0.5 percent or +/-0.2 ms, whichever is larger, of its nominal at 5, 25 and 50 WPM (dit 240, 48 and 24 ms; dah three dits; space one dit), each tolerance widened by one capture sample (0.001 ms), and throughout each loaded capture the display chip-select shows at least 50 full-frame transfers per second and each encoder's A and B lines show 50 +/-2 detents per second; otherwise Fail. The idle-encoder captures are held to the same limits.
instruments: Pico-based logic capture (second Pico 2 with sigrok-pico firmware read by sigrok-cli; planned, ADR-009), 3.3 V inputs, 1 MS/s unless a step states otherwise; credit-bearing after its TV record docs/cm/tool-validation/TV-NNN-logic-capture.md

Keying fixture: optocoupler contacts across the key-jack tip and ring, driven by a Pico 2 running the scripted closure pattern of the step, pattern timing from its crystal (docs/vv/fixtures/keying-fixture.md, planned)
Encoder-turning fixture turning both encoders at a set detent rate (docs/vv/fixtures/encoder-turner.md, planned)
50 ohm BNC dummy load with SMA adapter, power rating recorded in the report
Adjustable bench supply, 0 to 30 V, current limit set per step
Owner's straight key and iambic paddle, 3.5 mm TRS plugs (SI-034)

test_cases.title: Keyer speed settings 5 to 50 WPM in 1 WPM steps accepted and applied; out-of-range values rejected
